pageProps.title: A Beautiful Weapon
pageProps.review: A review of Keigo Higashino's novel that sharply criticizes the dark side of doping, bioethics, and a success-oriented society through the downfall of characters who discarded human dignity for the success of a gold medal.
pageProps.description: The corruption of sportsmanship and the loss of humanity
pageProps.content:
## Review Set in the cold world of sports where one cannot survive without being first, it shows the downfall of characters who discarded even human dignity for the ```beauty``` of a gold medal.
It is based on criticism of doping issues, bioethics, and a success-oriented society.
At the threshold of death, the athletes realize that the manipulated gold medals and trophies they tried to protect with their lives were merely ```junk```. The survive's final monologue, ```What on earth was I running for?```, seems to well express what the author wanted to convey through this work.
